events.title: Informatics (M.Sc.)
events.subtitle: Technical University of Munich
events.content: Since the winter semester 2026/27, I have been studying for a master's degree in Informatics at the Technical University of Munich. My specialization is Machine Learning and Analytics, complemented by the areas Scientific Computing and High Performance Computing as well as Security and Privacy.

events.title: Cyber Security (B.Sc.)
events.subtitle: University of Bonn
events.content: I studied Cyber Security at the University of Bonn and completed my degree in March 2026. I wrote my bachelor's thesis on the analysis of encrypted SMB traffic. During my studies, I focused intensively on IT security, cryptography and digital forensics.

events.title: Cyber Analysis and Defense
events.subtitle: Fraunhofer FKIE
events.content: I work as a student assistant at the _Fraunhofer Institute for Communication, Information Processing and Ergonomics_ (FKIE) in the _Cyber Analysis and Defense_ department, where I conduct independent research on the forensic analysis of network traffic, particularly of encrypted protocols.

events.title: Mobile Incident Response Team
events.subtitle: Federal Office for Information Security
events.content: During my six-week internship at the _Federal Office for Information Security_ in the _Mobile Incident Response Team_, I gained insights into operational cybersecurity, particularly in how to deal with security incidents, and was able to contribute to a system for managing evidence.

events.title: Abitur
events.subtitle: Hans-Thoma-Gymnasium Lörrach
events.content: I obtained my Abitur (German university entrance qualification) at Hans-Thoma-Gymnasium with a grade of 1.3 and the major subjects mathematics, computer science and physics. During my school years, I was active at the _phaenovum_ student research centre and took part in several competitions, including _ICYS Malaysia_, _GYPT_ and _Jugend forscht_.

person.name: Carl Gadde
person.bioShort: Hi, I'm Carl. I completed my bachelor's degree in Cyber Security at the University of Bonn and am now studying for a master's degree in Informatics at TUM. Alongside my studies, I work as a student assistant at Fraunhofer FKIE. I'm still very interested in IT security, but in my master's I want to focus more on machine learning and AI. Hardly any field is evolving as quickly right now, and I'm fascinated to see what AI systems are now capable of.
